1.consolidated_definition: dep. Acelerar. Avanzar al máximo en un tramo corto. Anglicismo semiadaptado, poco frecuente. Se da una serie de vueltas durante 20 minutos, con la particularidad de que cada dos vueltas se eliminan de uno a dos corredores, lo que los obliga a sprintear para no quedarse atrás (El Nuevo Día, 15-09-02)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To accelerate. To advance at maximum speed over a short distance. Semi-adapted Anglicism, relatively infrequent. A series of laps is completed in 20 minutes, with the particularity that every two laps, one to two runners are eliminated, forcing them to sprint to avoid falling behind (The New Day, 09-15-02)
